stackguardian.ui:title: StackGuardian Platform
stackguardian.ui:description: Connection details used by the runner to register itself with the StackGuardian platform.

api_uri.ui:description: Region of the StackGuardian control plane your organization runs in.

api_key.ui:description: Your organization's API key (sgo_*/sgu_*) or a secret reference (${secret::SECRET_NAME}).

org_name.ui:description: Override the StackGuardian organization name. Leave blank to derive it from the API key.

azure_location.ui:description: Azure region where the VM Scale Set and supporting resources are deployed.

resource_group_name.ui:description: Name of the existing Azure Resource Group where resources will be created.

runner_group_name.ui:description: Name of the StackGuardian runner group these VMSS instances will register against (output of the runner_group module).

runner_group_token.ui:description: Registration token for the runner group (output of the runner_group module). Use a secret reference.

storage_backend_identity_id.ui:description: Resource ID of the User-Assigned Managed Identity used by runners to access the storage backend (output of the runner_group module).

vm_image_id.ui:description: Custom Azure image ID with docker, cron, jq, and sg-runner pre-installed (typically built via the sibling Packer module).

vm_size.ui:description: VM SKU for each scale-set instance. Minimum 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM recommended.

network.ui:title: Network
network.ui:description: Either supply existing VNet/Subnet IDs or create a new VNet and Subnet.

create_network.ui:description: Create a new VNet and Subnet for the runner. When false, you must provide existing VNet and Subnet IDs.

vnet_id.ui:description: Resource ID of an existing Virtual Network.

subnet_id.ui:description: Resource ID of an existing Subnet within the VNet above.

vnet_address_space.ui:description: CIDR blocks for the new VNet.

subnet_address_prefix.ui:description: CIDR for the new subnet inside the VNet address space.

create_network_infrastructure.ui:description: Create a NAT Gateway with public IP and associate it with the (created) subnet for outbound internet access.

proxy_url.ui:description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for private network deployments.

additional_nsg_ids.ui:description: Additional NSG resource IDs to associate with each instance.

service_endpoints.ui:description: VNet service endpoints enabled on the subnet this template creates, so runners reach Azure PaaS over the Azure backbone (e.g. Microsoft.Storage, Microsoft.KeyVault, Microsoft.ContainerRegistry). Ignored when using an existing subnet.

os_disk.ui:title: OS Disk
os_disk.ui:description: OS disk configuration for each scale-set instance.

disk_size_gb.ui:description: OS disk size in GB. Minimum 30.

firewall.ui:title: Firewall & SSH
firewall.ui:description: SSH access and additional inbound rules for the NSG attached to each instance.

admin_username.ui:description: Linux admin user on each instance.

generate_ssh_key.ui:description: **Warning:** when true, an RSA keypair is generated and the private key is stored in Terraform state and exposed as a sensitive output. Prefer providing your own ssh_public_key.

ssh_public_key.ui:description: SSH public key authorized to log in as the admin user.

ssh_access_rules.ui:description: Map of friendly names to source CIDRs allowed to reach port 22 (e.g. office: 1.2.3.4/32).

additional_inbound_rules.ui:description: Map of named NSG inbound rules. Keys are rule names; values configure priority, protocol, ports and source CIDRs.

scaling.ui:title: Scaling
scaling.ui:description: Capacity bounds for the VM Scale Set. The autoscaler drives instance count between min and max.

min_size.ui:description: Floor on instance count. Must be at least 1.

max_size.ui:description: Ceiling on instance count. Must be greater than or equal to min_size.

desired_capacity.ui:description: Initial instance count. Must be between min_size and max_size.

upgrade_policy.ui:title: Upgrade Policy
upgrade_policy.ui:description: How the scale set rolls out a new image or VM size. Manual keeps the current behaviour: running instances are left alone until the autoscaler or an operator replaces them.

mode.ui:description: Manual leaves existing instances on the old model. Rolling replaces them in batches. Both Rolling and Automatic require a health signal below. **Warning:** changing this on a deployed stack replaces the VM Scale Set and recreates every runner.

health_probe_id.ui:description: Load Balancer probe used to judge instance health. Leave blank and use the Application Health Extension when there is no load balancer.

application_health_extension.ui:description: Installs the in-guest Application Health extension, which probes the instance locally - the simplest health signal for a runner fleet with no load balancer. Leave unset for Manual upgrades.

protocol.ui:description: tcp opens a socket, http/https issue a request against the path below.

port.ui:description: Local port probed on each instance (22 targets sshd, which the runner image already runs).

request_path.ui:description: Path requested when protocol is http or https. Required for those protocols.

max_batch_instance_percent.ui:description: Percent of instances upgraded in a single batch.

max_unhealthy_instance_percent.ui:description: Percent of instances allowed to be unhealthy during the upgrade. Must be greater than or equal to the batch percent.

max_unhealthy_upgraded_instance_percent.ui:description: Percent of already-upgraded instances allowed to be unhealthy before the upgrade aborts.

pause_time_between_batches.ui:description: ISO 8601 duration to wait between batches, giving new runners time to register.

automatic_instance_repair.ui:description: Let Azure replace instances that report unhealthy. Requires a health signal.

automatic_instance_repair_grace_period.ui:description: ISO 8601 grace period after a state change before repairs kick in (30-90 minutes).

runner_startup_timeout.ui:description: Maximum seconds to wait for Docker to start before shutting down each instance.

override_names.ui:title: Resource Naming
override_names.ui:description: Customize the prefix used for naming Azure resources created by this module.

global_prefix.ui:description: Prefix used for naming all Azure resources created by this module.

include_org_in_prefix.ui:description: When true, appends the StackGuardian organization name to the prefix (e.g. SG_RUNNER_demo-org). The org name comes from the StackGuardian Platform section above.
